title: The Day the River Spoke
subject: english
introduction: 'The Day the River Spoke' is explored as a Gurukul learning experience built around close reading, inference, and character or speaker perspective. Learners are expected to explain, connect, question and apply the ideas rather than reproduce textbook wording.

concepts.name: close reading
concepts.chapterConnection: 'The Day the River Spoke' develops this idea through its topic, examples, questions or situations.
concepts.originalExplanation: Understand close reading by identifying what it means in the context of 'The Day the River Spoke', what evidence supports it, and how it can be used in a new situation.
concepts.examplePrompt: Give a fresh example of close reading connected with 'The Day the River Spoke'.
concepts.nonExamplePrompt: Give a case that may look related to close reading but does not actually demonstrate it, and explain why.
